notes.title: PLAYTEST SURVEY and FAQ
notes.content:
Hiya and welcome to our playtest page!!!

Thanks for (potentially) signing on to help us out via Playtesting! 

we're super keen to hear any/all feedback and really appreciate anyone who takes the time to check out our project while we're still early in development. this playtest features the 20 minute linear build we showcased at PAX Melbourne 2024

ːsteammockingː our current playtest event will be running until December 31st 2024 ːsteammockingː

 give us playtest feedback
 Check out our Playtest FAQ

Player feedback from events like PAX Australia and SXSW have helped us shape our characters and gameplay a bunch already, and we're excited 2 learn more about the kinds of things YOU are looking from a Detective / Dating / Art School Supernatural Adventure Game like ours!

feel free to come chat with us on our slow slow Discord, or send us an email through our contact form

thanks xoxo fnife gAme s ːsteamthisː
